canonical_data: Local project files plus a separate versioned plan/diff sandbox with branching, held locally or on a self-hosted server
current_repo_note: Plandex Cloud (the hosted offering) began winding down 2025-10-03 and no longer accepts new users; self-hosted/local mode is the only supported path going forward, and the repository has had no commits since that announcement.
strengths: Built for very large projects and context (2M token budget, tree-sitter project maps)
Cumulative diff review sandbox keeps AI changes isolated until accepted, with rollback
Multi-provider model support across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and open-source models
weaknesses: No commits since the October 2025 Plandex Cloud wind-down announcement, roughly eleven months of inactivity
The hosted Plandex Cloud option is discontinued and no longer accepting new users, leaving only self-hosted/local mode
No MCP or plugin ecosystem documented
why_it_matters: A terminal agent purpose-built for large multi-file tasks with an explicit diff-review safety boundary, now a dormant but still-installable reference design.
